graph.name: Count settled messages · Pre
graph.description:
Count distinct eligible settled public messages, avoiding duplicate ticks within the retained evidence window.

Lesson: Track unions eligible settled public message IDs once each. Its bounded count does not classify domain actions.

Limitations: Native Events are public messages, not classified actions. Every retained track ID must remain in current settled evidence; the 64-position horizon needs explicit reconciliation/archive support. Domain clocks need an Event Mapper/Filter. Metadata saves may be unconfirmed.

Opening makes this example the active workflow document. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Pre: at most 0 auxiliary calls. Preview before publishing or applying.

Try changing:
Inspect identical Track inputs twice; compare count and addedCount.
Rename Track ID “ferry-wait”; update both field paths for an independent clock.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Event input: The clock contains e1 and e2. Current settled Events contains e1, e2, e3; only e3 is new.

Deterministic result: Clock = 3 distinct events: e1, e2, e3. Replaying that same settled evidence keeps it at 3.

Count messages: Post: zero calls; full Run writes locally without review, save may be unconfirmed.

Read the clock: Pre: exact paths, empty-state defaults, zero calls; no automatic consequence.

Evidence horizon: ≤64 IDs/refs; all retained IDs must remain in current evidence. Longer histories need reconciliation/archive. No domain-event detector.
